correctness_basis: Elementwise 2 percent relative plus .002 absolute; BF16 unit roundoff .00390625; output tree/dtype/finite exact; A/A exact. No tolerance changes after registration. FP32 deviation is reported separately, not task accuracy.
claim_scope: Random-input, untrained real-model inference systems performance; no scientific task accuracy or time-to-quality claim.
missing_outcomes: No imputation; conditional valid-pair effects and unbounded all-planned effect without additional assumptions.
final_release: Independent pilot dev/cal/final each >=5 qualified lineages, >=11/12 engineering pairs, dev/cal terminal, all policy predictions frozen. ACRE certificate is separate. No effect-sign gate.
